name: Self-order tablet product detail screen
describe: TabletLayout with screen === "detail": ProductDetail replaces the menu grid inside the 68% main pane (the header and the 32% CartPanel stay): Back link, full-width image, name 20/600, description, rate 18/500, Variants and Add-ons option rows, round -/+ quantity stepper and a full-width rounded-full "Add to cart" button.

Opened when product_detail_enabled is set and a card is tapped. The detail image is a wide sample photo (the source image keeps its natural aspect ratio). RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
